terminals.name: Root
terminals.description: General commands, git, make targets

terminals.name: Dev
terminals.description: Leave running: npm run dev:all:watch (main + management). Focused: npm run dev:main:all (no admin). Stuck :3000: npm run dev:api:stop from Root.

terminals.name: Docker
terminals.description: Docker and make commands

terminals.name: Workers
terminals.description: Leave-running consumers: npm run dev:workers:parsers (rss-on-demand, rss-normal, rss-live, add-by-rss-on-demand, add-by-rss-background, opml-import, live-item listener). Not npm run dev:workers — that only recompiles. Not crons. Image shrink / DLQ are separate. Optional one-shots: trending/P20/music seed, scheduled_jobs_run_due.

terminals.name: Tools
terminals.description: Tools development

terminals.name: Mobile
terminals.description: One-shots: build:packages; make mobile_e2e_deps; make mobile_e2e_seed; mobile:e2e:api:health; mobile:e2e:test-assets:health; open reports. Not for Metro/API/test-assets (those block).

terminals.name: Mobile Metro
terminals.description: Leave running :8081 for local. npm run mobile:dev (API :3000). USB phone: mobile:dev:device. Cache clear: mobile:dev:clear. Stop before Mobile E2E Metro — only one Metro on :8081.

terminals.name: Mobile iOS
terminals.description: Manual install/run (exits when done; --no-bundler always). npm run mobile:ios -- --device "iPhone 17 Pro". Metro in Mobile Metro. E2E installs: Mobile E2E iOS.

terminals.name: Mobile Android
terminals.description: Manual install/run (exits when done; --no-bundler always). Emulator: npm run mobile:android -- --device Pixel_6_Pro_API_33. USB: mobile:android:device. Metro in Mobile Metro. E2E installs: Mobile E2E Android.

terminals.name: Mobile CarPlay
terminals.description: Car group anchor. iOS CarPlay Simulator car checks: force-quit app (xcrun simctl terminate booted com.podverse.app.next), log stream (native-cache/carplay), App Group cache inspection. Enable the CarPlay window via Simulator I/O ▸ External Displays ▸ CarPlay. App must be built/installed from Mobile iOS; Metro in Mobile Metro.

terminals.name: Mobile Android Auto
terminals.description: Android Auto DHU car checks (splits from Mobile CarPlay): launch desktop-head-unit, adb forward tcp:5277, logcat for PodverseMediaLibraryService. Emulator/phone from Mobile Android + Metro in Mobile Metro must already be running.

terminals.name: Mobile E2E Metro
terminals.description: Leave running :8081 for Maestro. npm run mobile:dev:e2e (API :4230). Stop Dev and Mobile Metro first. After E2E: stop this, restart Dev + Mobile Metro, reload iPhone 17 Pro.

terminals.name: Mobile E2E iOS
terminals.description: E2E install/run (exits when done; --no-bundler always). Phone: npm run mobile:e2e:ios. Tablet: npm run mobile:e2e:ios:tablet. Metro in Mobile E2E Metro.

terminals.name: Mobile E2E Android
terminals.description: E2E install/run (exits when done; --no-bundler always). Phone: npm run mobile:e2e:android. Tablet: npm run mobile:e2e:android:tablet. Metro in Mobile E2E Metro.

terminals.name: Mobile E2E API
terminals.description: Leave running for API-backed E2E: npm run mobile:e2e:api:bg (:4230). Skip for UI-only. Runner manages restart around database reseeding; no restart needed when only Metro restarts if :4230 is healthy.

terminals.name: Mobile E2E test-assets
terminals.description: Leave running :2111 for Maestro (BIND 0.0.0.0). npm run mobile:e2e:test-assets. Do not reuse Dev's dev:test-assets — stop Dev first if :2111 is busy. Health: mobile:e2e:test-assets:health.

terminals.name: Mobile Maestro
terminals.description: Run then exit: npm run mobile:e2e:test:all (full suite) or npm run mobile:e2e:test -- <area>. Needs Mobile E2E Metro + Mobile E2E iOS / Mobile E2E Android installs; + E2E API for API-backed / :all; + test-assets for playback flows.
